html:
SMTO-EXE-0255 — SMTO can't record your own clicks and typing as a workflow

GUID: 5ceb9d79-fb82-599a-8a28-070d7dd44162
Slug: recipe-recording-unavailable
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: recipes

What happened

  • SMTO can't watch what you do on your computer and turn it into a workflow; this isn't available on Linux, Windows or macOS. Nothing was recorded.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Describe the job in a conversation and let SMTO do it. SMTO can save requests it carried out itself, but not actions you did by hand.
  2. When it's done, select Save to workflow on your message, review it, and select Save workflow. This keeps your exact request and settings so you can reuse them.
  3. Open Workflows and select Run now, or Schedule, whenever you need the job done again. Each run starts a fresh task from your saved request.

What success looks like

  • The workflow appears on the Workflows page, and Run now starts a new task from it.

If it still fails

  • No setting turns on recording of your own actions. If Save to workflow doesn't appear on your message, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • recording_support reports user-demonstration recording as unavailable on Linux, Windows and macOS because the Desktop, UI, Browser and Clipboard adapters expose no scoped user-action event subscription.

What this means

  • Recording support explicitly returns unavailable on Linux, Windows and macOS because the current adapters expose no scoped semantic user-action subscription. Workflow diagnostics do not execute steps or grant approval. Preserve the pinned definition, original receipts, completed effects and any uncertainty; all execution uses the existing authorization boundary.

Why this can happen

  • Recording support explicitly returns unavailable on Linux, Windows and macOS because the current adapters expose no scoped semantic user-action subscription.

How to diagnose it

  • Check recording_support; this is an absent adapter feature, not a permission prompt waiting to be approved.

How to fix it

  • This is a product limitation, not a configuration fault: recorder.recording_support always returns available=false and starts no keystroke, clipboard or screen recorder. Create workflows from Agent requests instead (saved-request workflows via Save to workflow).
  • Capture a completed supported Agent run instead of attempting user-action recording.

Retry and execution caution

  • Review the workflow and its current run evidence before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • Use supported capture from an accepted Agent run; user-demonstration recording remains unavailable until implemented.

What not to do

  • Never repeat a write whose effect remains unknown.

Technical notes

  • Workflow diagnostics do not execute steps or grant approval. Preserve the pinned definition, original receipts, completed effects and any uncertainty; all execution uses the existing authorization boundary.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
